page: Microsoft Azure L48s_v3 is a storage-optimized server instance from the LSv3 family, powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8370C processor. This x86_64 architecture CPU features 24 physical cores and 48 vCPUs with hyper-threading enabled, running at a clock speed of 2.8 GHz. The processor includes a 48 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512, vector neural network instructions, and hardware-accelerated cryptography via AES and SHA extensions.

The instance is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB per vCPU. For local storage, the L48s_v3 includes 12,012 GB of high-speed NVMe SSD capacity, and it is premium storage capable. No GPU accelerators are included in this configuration. The underlying virtualization is managed by the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

Benchmark results indicate strong performance in memory-intensive and cryptographic operations, with a Passmark memory score of 2908.37 and a Passmark CPU encryption score of 43900.85. The server also demonstrates strong capabilities in image processing and ray tracing workloads. Given its massive local NVMe storage capacity and balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio, this server is well-suited for large-scale databases, transactional workloads, data warehousing, and high-throughput file systems.
